jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: one existing extra-wide 512x71 pixel-art grassy floating platform. Image 2 is ONLY the style guide for our unfinished sketch world. Convert image 1 into an unfinished line-drawing version of EXACTLY THE SAME platform: same length/thickness ratio, perfectly level top, same end caps, same hanging root placements, same leaf and stone silhouettes. Do not invent a new island shape or add a central bulge. Preserve the full horizontal outline and all transparent space outside it. Style A: clean sparse dark graphite pixel lines on warm ivory unpainted fills INSIDE the platform silhouette. The grass/top landing edge remains clear, small overlapping leaf contours beneath it, short roots and stones become loose partial outlines. Keep plenty of empty ivory inside the earth. Break a few minor interior lines like an unfinished drawing. NO dense pencil shading, crosshatching, charcoal fill, black soil core, paper rectangle, background scene, shadow, colored foliage, typography or numbers. Keep a coherent continuous drawing from left tip to right tip; no tile grid, squares, repeated panel borders, vertical dividers or seams. True transparent background outside the asset; the pale ivory interior is opaque. Render a single isolated long thin strip centered on the output with generous transparent margin. The sprite proportions must remain 512:71, do not stretch the thickness. It will be registered back to 512x71 and use the same landing baseline17px as the original. Preserve native pixel character, crisp restrained outlines, no blur, no watercolor.

One long thin strip, same512:71 proportion, centered with transparent margin. Genuine transparent exterior, ivory interior.
